faq.answer1    = <p><i>Sokker Asistent</i> je online aplik\u00E1cia, ktor\u00E1 v\u00E1m pom\u00F4\u017Ee spravova\u0165 v\u00E1\u0161 <a target="_blank" href="https://www.sokker.org">Sokker</a> t\u00EDm a dokonca aj n\u00E1rodn\u00FD t\u00EDm.</p>
faq.answer10   = <p>Projekcia v\u00E1m pom\u00F4\u017Ee vypo\u010D\u00EDta\u0165, ako by dan\u00FD hr\u00E1\u010D mohol vyzera\u0165 v bud\u00FAcnosti, ak by tr\u00E9noval ka\u017Ed\u00FD t\u00FD\u017Ede\u0148 na 100 %.</p>\r\n\r\n<p>Ak to chcete urobi\u0165, vyberte vek, od ktor\u00E9ho chcete, aby sa schopnosti hr\u00E1\u010Da prejavili a upravte talent pod\u013Ea svojich predst\u00E1v. Automaticky sa pripo\u010D\u00EDtaj\u00FA zv\u00FD\u0161enia schopnost\u00ED z\u00EDskan\u00E9 zo v\u0161eobecn\u00E9ho tr\u00E9ningu, ktor\u00E9 hr\u00E1\u010D nazbiera do dosiahnutia vybran\u00E9ho veku, a zobraz\u00ED sa zost\u00E1vaj\u00FAci po\u010Det Vami nastavite\u013En\u00FDch tr\u00E9ningov, ktor\u00E9 m\u00F4\u017Eete k tomu e\u0161te v sokkri pou\u017Ei\u0165. Ak si zv\u00FD\u0161te schopnosti pod\u013Ea svojich predst\u00E1v a ukazovate\u013E zost\u00E1vaj\u00FAcich tr\u00E9ningov sa zodpovedaj\u00FAcim sp\u00F4sobom zn\u00ED\u017Ei.</p>
faq.answer11   = <p>Tr\u00E9neri n\u00E1rodn\u00FDch t\u00EDmov r\u00F4znych kraj\u00EDn zvy\u010Dajne pou\u017E\u00EDvaj\u00FA t\u00FAto webov\u00FA str\u00E1nku na kontrolu hr\u00E1\u010Dov. Ak za\u0161krtnete pr\u00EDslu\u0161n\u00E9 pol\u00ED\u010Dko, <i>Sokker Asistent</i> automaticky odo\u0161le schopnosti va\u0161ich hr\u00E1\u010Dov na tieto webov\u00E9 str\u00E1nky:</p>
faq.answer13   = <p>Aby sa overila spr\u00E1vnos\u0165 tvojho hesla, <i>Sokker Asistent</i> sa mus\u00ED pripoji\u0165 k <i>Sokkeru</i>, s povolen\u00FDm CORS, ktor\u00FD nie je v prehliada\u010Doch z bezpe\u010Dnostn\u00FDch d\u00F4vodov be\u017Ene povolen\u00FD.</p>\r\n\r\n<p>Je nieko\u013Eko sp\u00F4sobov, ako povolenie zase zru\u0161i\u0165. <b>POZN\u00C1MKA:</b> Pou\u017Eitie CORS nesie riziko a nerad\u00EDme prehliada\u0165 nebezpe\u010Dn\u00E9 weby, ke\u010F je povolen\u00FD. Mo\u017Enosti pou\u017E\u00EDvania:</p>\r\n\r\n<ol>\r\n<li> <b>Nain\u0161talujte si doplnok do prehliada\u010Da a povo\u013Ete, \u010Di zak\u00E1\u017Ete si ho v\u017Edy pod\u013Ea potreby nieko\u013Ek\u00FDmi kliknutiami: <br/>\r\n<a href='https://mybrowseraddon.com/access-control-allow-origin.html'> Klikni sem na CORS plugin </a>\r\n</li>\r\n<div align = "center">\r\n<img class = "shadow" style = "margin-left: -22px;" src = 'img/faq/cors_plugin.png' /><br/>\r\n</div>\r\n\r\n<li> <b>Vytvorte odkaz na ploche pre prehliada\u010D s CORS a pou\u017E\u00EDvajte ho iba na navig\u00E1ciu v <i>Sokker Asistent</i> <br/>\r\n<b> Opera: </b> "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Opera\\launcher.exe" --disable-web-security --user-data-dir = "c:\\nocorsbrowserdata" <br />\r\n<b> Chrome: </b> "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe" --disable-web-security --user-data-dir = "c:\\nocorsbrowserdata"\r\n</li>\r\n<div align = "center">\r\n<img class = "shadow" style = "margin-left: -22px;" src = 'img/faq/cors_shortcut.png' />\r\n</div>\r\n\r\n<li> <b>Pou\u017Eite Android <a href="/sokker/app/SokkerAsistente.apk">app</a></b>.</li>\r\n\r\n<li> <b>Prehliada\u010D Yandex </b> (je k dispoz\u00EDcii pre <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yandex.browser.alpha">Android</a> aj <a href="https://apps.apple.com/es/app/yandex-browser/id483693909">iPhone</a>). Umo\u017E\u0148uje do seba in\u0161talova\u0165 doplnok CORS z Chrome.</li>\r\n</ol>
